WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id
)
SELECT
  input.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  jobs.id AS job_id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.last_error,
  jobs.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  COUNT(scenes.id)::int AS scene_count,
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'scene_id', scenes.id,
        'scene_number', scenes.scene_number,
        'narration', scenes.narration,
        'visual_description', scenes.visual_description,
        'visual_query', scenes.visual_query,
        'visual_subject_type', scenes.visual_subject_type,
        'audio_path', scenes.audio_path,
        'duration_seconds', scenes.duration_seconds,
        'visual_path', scenes.visual_path,
        'status', scenes.status,
        'asset_count', (
          SELECT COUNT(*)::int
          FROM public.assets assets
          WHERE assets.scene_id = scenes.id
        )
      )
      ORDER BY scenes.scene_number
    ) FILTER (WHERE scenes.id IS NOT NULL),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS scenes
FROM input
LEFT JOIN public.jobs
  ON jobs.id = input.job_id
LEFT JOIN public.scenes
  ON scenes.job_id = jobs.id
GROUP BY
  input.job_id,
  jobs.id,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.last_error;

WITH transitioned AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    current_stage = 'visuals',
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'voiceover'
  RETURNING
    id,
    status,
    current_stage
),
resumed AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    current_stage = 'visuals',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'failed'
    AND current_stage = 'visuals'
  RETURNING
    id,
    status,
    current_stage
),
existing AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    status,
    current_stage
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND current_stage = 'visuals'
),
ready AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    status,
    current_stage,
    true AS started_now
  FROM transitioned

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    id,
    status,
    current_stage,
    true AS started_now
  FROM resumed

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    id,
    status,
    current_stage,
    false AS started_now
  FROM existing

  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ready
  ) AS ready_to_run,
  (
    SELECT status
    FROM ready
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS status,
  (
    SELECT current_stage
    FROM ready
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT started_now
      FROM ready
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    false
  ) AS started_now;

WITH target_scene AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.scenes
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND job_id = $2::uuid
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM(visual_path), '') IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.assets (
    scene_id,
    provider,
    provider_asset_id,
    source_url,
    author,
    license,
    license_url,
    local_path,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $1::uuid,
    $3::text,
    NULLIF($4::text, ''),
    NULLIF($5::text, ''),
    NULLIF($6::text, ''),
    NULLIF($7::text, ''),
    NULLIF($8::text, ''),
    $9::text,
    $10::jsonb
  FROM target_scene
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.assets
    WHERE scene_id = $1::uuid
  )
  RETURNING id
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE public.scenes
  SET
    visual_path = $9::text,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND job_id = $2::uuid
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM($9::text), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM inserted
    )
  RETURNING
    id,
    job_id,
    scene_number,
    visual_path
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS scene_id,
  $2::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inserted
  ) AS asset_inserted,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM updated
  ) AS scene_updated,
  (
    SELECT id
    FROM inserted
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS asset_id,
  (
    SELECT scene_number
    FROM updated
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS scene_number,
  (
    SELECT visual_path
    FROM updated
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS visual_path,
  (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated)
  ) AS persisted;

WITH job_state AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    status,
    current_stage,
    target_duration_seconds,
    CASE target_duration_seconds
      WHEN 15 THEN 4
      WHEN 30 THEN 8
      WHEN 45 THEN 12
      WHEN 60 THEN 15
      ELSE NULL
    END AS required_scene_count
  FROM public.jobs
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
),
scene_state AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_scene_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(scenes.visual_path), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.assets
          WHERE assets.scene_id = scenes.id
        )
    )::int AS ready_scene_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(scenes.visual_path), '') IS NULL
         OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM public.assets
           WHERE assets.scene_id = scenes.id
         )
    )::int AS incomplete_scene_count
  FROM public.scenes scenes
  WHERE scenes.job_id = $1::uuid
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM job_state
  ) AS job_exists,
  job_state.status,
  job_state.current_stage,
  job_state.target_duration_seconds,
  job_state.required_scene_count,
  scene_state.total_scene_count,
  scene_state.ready_scene_count,
  scene_state.incomplete_scene_count,
  (
    job_state.status = 'processing'
    AND job_state.current_stage = 'visuals'
    AND job_state.required_scene_count IS NOT NULL
    AND scene_state.total_scene_count = job_state.required_scene_count
    AND scene_state.ready_scene_count = job_state.required_scene_count
    AND scene_state.incomplete_scene_count = 0
  ) AS all_visuals_ready
FROM job_state
CROSS JOIN scene_state;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs
  SET
    status = 'failed',
    current_stage = 'visuals',
    last_error = CASE
      WHEN status = 'failed'
        AND NULLIF(BTRIM(last_error), '') IS NOT NULL
      THEN last_error
      ELSE LEFT($2::text, 4000)
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
    AND current_stage = 'visuals'
    AND status IN ('processing', 'failed')
  RETURNING
    id,
    status,
    current_stage,
    last_error
)
SELECT
  $1::uuid AS job_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM updated
  ) AS failure_recorded,
  (
    SELECT status
    FROM updated
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS status,
  (
    SELECT current_stage
    FROM updated
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS current_stage,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT last_error
      FROM updated
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    LEFT($2::text, 4000)
  ) AS last_error;
